name: QuickShulker263
description: Quickly open shulker boxes (and ender chests, crafting tables, stonecutters) without placing them down, for Minecraft 1.21.1. Unofficial port of QuickShulker by kyrptonaught (MIT, https://github.com/kyrptonaught/quickshulker). Press K or right-click a held item to open it. All credit for the original concept and logic goes to kyrptonaught. See NOTICE.
